description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing its contents, used in unit tests for the 'ut_test_common' module. It includes file handling, memory allocation, and printing routines, along with external dependencies on standard C libraries and the 'ut_test_common.h' header.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a provided memory structure, handling errors and resource management.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file and/or a given key-value pair string, utilizing the read_file_into_memory function.
